findings: Several distractors are too easily dismissed; further revision needed before installation
Question 25 now compares actual add-on treatments with discriminating rate, iron and volume findings
Question 59 removes arrest-only and arbitrary-drug-count referral alternatives
Questions 7 and 8 now compare credible investigations: functional testing versus resting testing/CMR, and CMR versus biopsy/PET/genetics; individualized clinical roles explained

Question 23 compares urgent assessment with dose adjustment, interaction withdrawal and antidote; question 45 compares thiazide addition, ultrafiltration, aquaresis and oral loop switch with discriminating sodium/renal/IV-exposure findings
CRT selection now compares actual device strategies; ineffective CRT in AF compares chamber-rate intervention with lead revision, ectopy ablation and timing optimization
NSAID mechanism distractors now compare genuine medication-related edema/HF mechanisms; ivabradine question uses four actual HF add-on drugs without giveaway option qualifications
Pulmonary edema alternatives revised to actual oxygen/ventilation strategies and acute pressure/decongestion treatments; removed fixed unmonitored nitrate and delayed-respiratory-support giveaways
Question 57 now compares four actual vasoactive drugs; added a finite priority revision queue from the full option-set review
Question 4 now tests the investigation resolving a discordant peptide; question 6 distinguishes diagnostic probability from future risk and invasive confirmation

Exercise PAWP question now compares close pressure patterns within one defined protocol; foundational initiation question compares realistic class sequences rather than unnecessary diuretic escalation
Beta-blocker choices compare actual evidence-based agents with starting versus target-dose distinctions; MRA choices compare realistic low-dose regimens and reassessment at potassium 5.2
Dapagliflozin choices compare doses/frequencies and indication-specific renal thresholds; orthostasis question uses four medication names with pulse, potassium and absence of loop exposure specified

ACE inhibitor question now compares continued monitoring, interruption, dose reduction and ARB substitution; DIAMOND options now distinguish endpoints and run-in design rather than implausible universal prescribing claims
Remission and maintenance-diuretic alternatives now compare realistic de-escalation strategies; torsemide survival claim checked against original TRANSFORM-HF report
Hydralazine/nitrate question compares actual vasodilator combinations; iron question compares routes and plausible deferral strategies with deficiency criteria retained
AF cardiomyopathy alternatives compare rate strategy, stricter rate target and ablate/pace; ASV alternatives test primary endpoint, later trial and guideline disagreement
DELIVER choices distinguish mortality, first-event versus recurrent-event analysis and urgent visits; finerenone options now all compare plausible starting/target-dose pairs with balanced wording
Obesity trials now test competing endpoint assignments; persistent HFpEF limitation now specifies adequate rate and volume control and compares rehabilitation with actual drug strategies
ICD options compare permanent, resynchronization, wearable and deferred strategies; advanced referral options compare realistic optimization, inotrope and renal-workup sequences
CPET question compares close absolute thresholds with beta-blocker attribution; LVAD question replaces a caregiver giveaway with a competing hemodynamic finding
Palliative alternatives now compare concrete care pathways; decompensation workup compares CTPA, angiography and biomarker-led assessment with broad immediate cardiac evaluation

ADVOR alternatives distinguish actual dose/route and endpoint rather than extreme eligibility claims; creatinine question compares temporary pause, ultrafiltration and inotropy with continued monitored decongestion
Routine inotrope options now compare concrete strategies without universal wording; STRONG-HF options compare plausible follow-up schedules and biomarker-guided management
Normotensive shock choices compare actual physiological diagnoses; invasive monitoring question compares four clinical monitoring approaches without sole-guide giveaways
Perfusion reassessment options compare actual next interventions; RV support options now use short device descriptions with no obligatory/equivalent wording clues
Three support-trial questions now distinguish actual comparators, endpoints, safety results and nonrandomized timing rather than blanket device claims
Final flagged options revised: ECMO distention compares actual support interventions; bridge decision compares realistic destinations rather than unmonitored removal or indefinite support
Question 5 updated to refer to the correct pressure-pattern option rather than a measurement no longer supplied in the revised stem
Question 7 needs a more complete criteria table to make the HFA-PEFF explanation independently useful
HFA-PEFF criteria-table gap addressed using original consensus PDF
Explanations 21-40 checked against revised stems; added required subtle dose/threshold highlighting to selected prescribing and CPET explanations
Explanations 41-65 read and checked; SCAI stage comparison table and selected dose/threshold highlights added without marking options
